text.p: Environmental Products & Technologies Corp said Friday that it has delayed closing the acquisition of White Mountain Natural Products Inc because of lack of performance on behalf of the sellers.
Environmental Products said it fully intends to pursue its rights under the agreement between the parties, and it is confident that the matter will be resolved in its favor.
The delay in closing the transaction will postpone Environmental Products ability to file its application for listing of its shares for trading on the Nasdaq - Small Cap Market, it said.
The company is focused on solving environmental problems while enhancing the productivity of farming and large livestock raising operations in the U.S.
